critical_code_review_comments: routers/courses/crud.py get_course still uses c.slides for slide_count via _detail (len(c.slides)) — that lazy load remains. Only enrollment_count was fixed to use scalar count in the detail path. Not a bug (slides are needed anyway to serialize into the response), just noting the asymmetry vs list_courses.

_range_response regex `bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$` correctly rejects unusable ranges (returns None -> falls through to FileResponse 200). Multi-range (comma-separated) is not supported but that is acceptable for HTML5 <video>.

Range branch only fires when storage.local_path(path) is not None — object-store paths bypass Range serving entirely. Acceptable for current local-storage deployment; worth documenting for future S3/GCS switch.
